newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot naphtha steady as gas oil firms crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot naphtha steady as gas oil firms crude.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha prices held steady in late trade on Thursday.

Traders said volatile but firmer crude, boosted by gas oil futures short covering ahead of next weeks diesel specification change was supportive, but trade was thin with many players away from their desks for an industry function.

Offers of full cargoes were scarce and pegged notionally around the $202-4 a tonne level. Traders said small 5-10kt pieces were offered by refiners at around $195 a tonne fob NWE, but buying interest was very thin.
